description: 后印度防御 E12 — 练习：局促中寻找出路

intro.popup_en:
Space Cramp, Practice 8 (Advanced)
Black has damaged White's pawn structure, but White has built a strong d4-e4 center. Black's pieces are cramped. How can they find a way out, and what is Black's best counterbreak?
intro.popup:
空间挤压 练习8（高级）

黑方破坏了白方兵形
但白方推出了e4，d4强中心

黑方子力局促，如何找出路？

核心问题：黑方的最佳反击是什么？

outro.popup_en: The freeing plan: ...e5! challenges d4 directly. If White captures with dxe5, ...Nc5 and ...Bb7 activate Black's pieces. When cramped, identify the central break and coordinate the pieces to carry it out.
outro.popup:
局促破解方案

最强反击：...e5！
直接挑战d4，
若dxe5→Nc5，Bb7激活！

局促 → 找核心破解手 → 组织执行
这是破局的标准路线！

moves.popup:
b6！后印度防御！
准备Bb7控制长对角线
moves.popup_en: ...b6! The Queen's Indian Defense setup prepares ...Bb7 to control the long diagonal.
...Bb4! The bishop pins Nc3. If White plays e4, Black can exchange with ...Bxc3 and damage White's pawn structure.
moves.popup:
Bb4！钉住Nc3！
若白方推e4，黑方Bxc3破坏兵形

moves.popup_en: Bg5! White takes the initiative, attacks Nf6, and prepares to complicate the position.
moves.popup:
Bg5！白方的主动！
攻击Nf6，同时准备对黑方的复杂化

moves.popup_en: ...Bb7! The bishop reaches the long diagonal, influencing d5 and e4.
moves.popup:
Bb7！象发展到长对角线
控制d5和e4方向

moves.popup_en: e3 reinforces the center and prepares Bxc4.
...h6 challenges the bishop and prevents it from maintaining the pin after Bh4.
Bh4 retreats while keeping Nf6 pinned.
...Bxc3+! Black exchanges decisively, damaging White's structure by inducing bxc3 and doubled c-pawns. The bishop gives itself up to disrupt White's pawn formation.
moves.popup:
Bxc3+！果断兑换！
破坏白方兵形（bxc3会形成双联兵）
黑方用象换马，目的是破坏白方结构

bxc3 白方形成c2+c3双联兵
但白方的c3+c4威力还在
moves.popup_en: bxc3 gives White doubled pawns on c2 and c3, though the c3-c4 pawn pair still controls space.

moves.popup: Nbd7 发展马，为e5或Nc5做准备

moves.popup_en: e4!! White establishes a powerful d4-e4 center and gains a large space advantage. Which pawn break can Black use to challenge it? The bishop on c8 is still undeveloped, another sign of Black's cramped position.
moves.popup:
e4！！白方强中心建立！

d4+e4，白方空间巨大！

⭐ 练习问题：
黑方现在最有力的反击是什么？
（提示：哪个兵推进能最有效挑战中心？）

c8象还没出来——这也是信号！
